d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Jazz, 115-100 tonight in Minnesota. Ayo Dosunmu finished with a team-high 26 points along with 4 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Timberwolves, while LaMelo Ball tallied 24 points, 5 assists and 4 three pointers in the game. Darryn Peterson recorded 26 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. The Timberwolves improve their record to 8-3 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-9 for the season.
